spans.s:
स्थ (स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
a. Staying.

स्थग् (ए) स्थगति 1.
a. To cover.

स्थग (गः-गा-गं)
a. Fraudulent; shame-
less.
f. (ई) Betel box.

स्थगन (नं) 1.
n. Covering, conceal-
ment.

स्थगित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Covered, hidden.

स्थगु (गुः) 2.
m. A hump on the back.

स्थण्डिल (लं) 1.
n. A square place
made for sacrifice; a boundary.

स्थाण्डिल (लः) 1.
m. A devotee sleep-
ing on sacrificial ground; a men-
dicant.

स्थण्डिल-शायिन् (यी) 5.
m. A devotee
who sleeps on the above.

स्थण्डिल-सितक (कं) 1.
n. An altar.

स्थण्डिले-शय (यः) 1.
m. A devotee as
above.

स्थपति (तिः) 2.
m. Performer of the
Vrihashpati sacrifice; guard of
the women's apartments; a king
or chief; architect; carpenter;
charioteer;
Kuvera. a. Chief,
principal.

स्थपुट (टः-टा-टं)
a. Distressed, bent with pain.

स्थल स्थलति 1.
a. To stand, be firm.

स्थल (लं-ली) 1.
n. 3.
f. Place, site,
soil, dry ground.
n. and 1.
f. A
spot drained and raised.
n. A
tent; a mound; a topic.

स्थाल (लं) 1.
n. A caldron.
f. (ई)
An earthen pot; trumpet flower.

स्थल-ज (जः-जा-जं)
a. Terrestrial.

स्थल-पद्म (द्मं) 1.
n. A shrub,
Hibis-
cus mutabilis.

स्थल-पद्मिनी (नी) 3.
f. Idem.

स्थल-मञ्जरी (री) 3.
f. A plant,
Achy-
ranthes aspera.

स्थल-विग्रह (हः) 1.
m. Battle on a plain.

स्थल-शृङ्गाट (टः) 1.
m. A plant,
Tri-
bulus lanuginosus.

स्थल-सीमन् (मा) 5.
m. A boundary,
land-mark.

स्थली-देवता (ता) 1.
f. A terrestrial
demigod; as a faun, dryad, &c.

स्थलीय (यः-या-यं)
a. Of dry ground.

स्थले-शय (यः) 1.
m. An amphibious
animal.

स्थवि (विः) 2.
m. A weaver.

स्थविर (रः) 1.
m. Brahmā; an old
man.
a. Old, firm.

स्थाविर (रं) 1.
n. Old age; above 50
years for women, 70 for men.

स्थविष्ठ (ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
a. Very fat or cor-
pulent. Also स्थवीयस्.

स्थाणु (णुः) 2.
m. Shiva; a stake; a
spear; nest of white ants.
m.
and
n. Trunk with branches lop-
ped off.
a. Fine, steady.

स्थाणु-छेद (दः) 1.
m. Wood-cutter.

स्थातव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. That should be
placed, fixed or appointed.

स्थातृ (ता-त्री-तृ)
a. Standing.

स्थान (नं) 1.
n. Place, situation;
stay; a house; a town; a sec-
tion; interval; likeness; sta-
tionary condition or attitude.

स्थानक (कं) 1.
n. Bason of water
at the root of a tree; a town;
a bubble on spirits of wine.

स्थान-चञ्चला (ला) 1.
f. A plant,
Ocymum pilosum.

स्थान-पाल (लः) 1.
m. A guard.

स्थान-भ्रष्ट (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
a. Displaced.

स्थाना_ध्यक्ष (क्षः) 1.
m. Governor of
a place or post.

स्थाना_सन-विहार-वत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Standing, sitting, and walk-
ing.

स्थाना_सेध (धः) 1.
m. Imprisonment.

स्थानिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Local.
m. The
governor of a place or post.

स्थानिन् (नी-निनी-नि)
a. Having
a place or situation; permanent.

स्थानीय (यं) 1.
n. A city.
a. Relating
to a place.
adv. Properly; because; like; truly.

स्थापक (कः-का-कं)
a. Placing, fixing,
regulating.
m. A stage manager,
founder of a temple, &c.

स्थापत्य (त्यः) 1.
m. A guard of the
woman's apartment.

स्थापन (नं) 1.
n. Fixing the mind,
abstraction; ceremony in the
month of utero-gestation; a dwel-
ling; placing; directing.
f. (आ)
Stage management; (ई) a plant,
Cissampelos.

स्थापित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Certain; ascer-
tained; fixed; deposited; found-
ed; firm; directed.

स्थापितवत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
p. Placing.

स्थामन् (म) 5.
n. Strength, power.

स्थायिन् (यी-यिनी-यि)
a. Steady, firm,
unchangeable; staying, &c.

स्थायि-भाव (वः) 1.
m. Fixed condi-
tion; a property or effect of
love, as joy, sorrow, fear, &c.

स्थायुक (कः) 1.
m. The overseer of
a village.
a. Steady, stationary.

स्थाली-पक्व (क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
a. Boiled in a
pot.

स्थालीविल (लः) 1.
n. The interior
or hollow of a boiler.

स्थालीविलीय (यः-या-यं)
a. Fit to be
boiled or dressed.

स्थावर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Fixed, immove-
able, regular.
m. A mountain.
n. A bow-string; real estate;
an heirloom.

स्था_सक (कः) 1.
m. Perfuming the
person; ornamental mark; a
bubble.

स्थासु (सु) 2.
n. Bodily strength or
capability.

स्थास्नु (स्नुः-स्नुः-स्नु)
a. Firm, stable, eternal.

स्थास्नुता (ता) 1.
f. Firmness.
